JUSTOLED.SECTION_CONNECTION_DOC: How the OLED is wired and which panel it is. Pick the wiring you used, or Custom and type the pins. Detect reads the I2C bus and says what answers; the panel is yours to choose, and Test display proves the choice.
JUSTOLED.CONNECTION_DOC: I2C: SDA on GPIO 2 (pin 3), SCL on GPIO 3 (pin 5), address found automatically. SPI generic: the wiring of mpd_oled and the luma library, DC on GPIO 24 (pin 18), RST on GPIO 25 (pin 22). SPI Waveshare: the wiring on Waveshare's module pages, DC on GPIO 25 (pin 22), RST on GPIO 27 (pin 13). Both use CE0 (pin 24) and, on a TFT LCD, the backlight on GPIO 18 (pin 12). SPI Pimoroni: the wiring of the Pirate Audio and Display HAT Mini, CE1 (pin 26), DC on GPIO 9 (pin 21), backlight on GPIO 13 (pin 33), no reset line. Custom shows the fields.
JUSTOLED.CONNECTION_I2C_CUSTOM: I2C, custom bus, pins or address
JUSTOLED.CONNECTION_SPI_PIRATE: SPI, Pimoroni HAT wiring (CE1, DC 9, BL 13)
JUSTOLED.PANEL_DOC: The controller and the pixel size, as printed on the module or its page. Every entry the daemon drives is listed; the wiki's Displays page says which are verified on a module and which are described from the data sheet.
JUSTOLED.I2C_BUS_DOC: The N of /dev/i2c-N. 1 is the Raspberry Pi's header bus, 0 the HAT EEPROM bus (GPIO 0 and 1, pins 27 and 28). 3 or higher makes a software bus on the two GPIOs below, written to /boot/userconfig.txt when you save; it takes a restart and is slower than a hardware bus.
JUSTOLED.I2C_PINS_DOC: BCM GPIO number for the software bus (bus number 3 or higher). The hardware buses have fixed pins and ignore this.
JUSTOLED.I2C_ADDRESS_DOC: Automatic tries 0x3C then 0x3D. Most modules sit at 0x3C; a solder pad or jumper on the module moves it to 0x3D.
JUSTOLED.I2C_SPEED_DOC: For an I2C module. At the Pi's 100 kHz a 128x64 frame takes about 90 ms, so the meter moves at 10 frames a second; 400 kHz, which these controllers are specified for, gives 25. 1 MHz is beyond their specification and works on many modules with short leads. Written to the boot configuration when you save; takes a restart. No effect on SPI or on a software bus.
JUSTOLED.SPI_BUS_DOC: The B of /dev/spidevB.C. Bus 0 is the header SPI on GPIO 10 (MOSI, pin 19) and GPIO 11 (SCLK, pin 23).
JUSTOLED.SPI_CS_DOC: The C of /dev/spidevB.C: 0 for CE0 (GPIO 8, pin 24), 1 for CE1 (GPIO 7, pin 26).
JUSTOLED.GPIO_DC_DOC: BCM number of the GPIO wired to the module's DC (D/C) pin. 24 in the generic wiring, 25 in Waveshare's.
JUSTOLED.GPIO_RESET_DOC: BCM number of the GPIO wired to the module's RST (RES) pin. 25 in the generic wiring, 27 in Waveshare's; -1 when the module has no reset pin.
JUSTOLED.GPIO_BL_DOC: BCM number of the GPIO wired to a TFT LCD's backlight pin, where that pin is a logic input: 18 on Waveshare's modules, 13 on Pimoroni's HATs. On a bare board whose BLK or LED pin is the backlight itself (the 2.8 inch ILI9341 boards, many ST7735 modules) the pin goes to 3.3 V, not to a GPIO; set -1. OLEDs have none.
JUSTOLED.ROTATE_DOC: Turn the picture to match how the module is mounted. An OLED turns half way; a TFT LCD turns by quarters too, so a portrait module shows the landscape layout.
JUSTOLED.ROTATE_270: Quarter turn the other way (270 degrees)
JUSTOLED.DETECT_DOC: Read the I2C bus and say what answers. SPI panels cannot be read; choose them by hand.
JUSTOLED.TEST_DOC: Draw a test pattern for a few seconds: a frame, the corners, the panel's name.
JUSTOLED.DETECTED_NOTHING: Nothing answers on bus {{bus}}. Check the wiring, VCC and GND, and that I2C is enabled.
JUSTOLED.DETECT_FAILED: The bus could not be read: {{error}}
JUSTOLED.TEST_SENT: The test pattern is on the display.
JUSTOLED.TEST_FAILED: The display daemon did not answer: {{error}}
JUSTOLED.SECTION_MESSAGES_DOC: What the display says as the player boots, stands ready, pauses, restarts and shuts down. Two lines, separated by |.
JUSTOLED.SHOW_LIFECYCLE_DOC: The display speaks from power-on, before Volumio is up, and says goodbye before power goes.
JUSTOLED.SECTION_FACE_DOC: What the display shows while music plays. The display follows a change at once.
JUSTOLED.FACE_DOC: The meter beside the track, or one without the other. The track is the title, artist and album as they fit the panel, with a progress line.
JUSTOLED.FACE_SPECTRUM_VU: Spectrum, left and right levels, and track
JUSTOLED.FACE_VU: Left and right levels and track
JUSTOLED.TRACK_TEXT_DOC: How many rows the track takes under the meter; fewer rows, and the time and format turned off, give the meter the room.
JUSTOLED.TRACK_TEXT_COMPACT: Title, then artist and album on one row
JUSTOLED.TRACK_TEXT_FULL: Title larger, artist and album on their own rows
JUSTOLED.TIME_DISPLAY_DOC: How far into the track the display counts; a radio stream shows the time played.
JUSTOLED.SHOW_FORMAT: Show the sample rate and bit depth
JUSTOLED.SHOW_FORMAT_DOC: 44.1k 16b beside the volume; a stream shows its bitrate.
JUSTOLED.PEAKS_DOC: A mark that holds a moment above each bar.
JUSTOLED.METER_GAIN_DOC: Lifts or lowers the meters, -12 to +12 dB. The meters read the music before the volume control, so a quiet recording can be given room and a loud one held back; 0 shows the recording as it is.
JUSTOLED.METER_WIDE_DOC: The meter takes the panel's full width and at least its upper half; the track and the time make do with the rest, the artist and album row and the format text going first. On a 128x64 panel: 32 bars over the title and the time, as mpd_oled lays it.
JUSTOLED.THEME_DOC: For a colour panel: the words, the bars, the peak mark and the progress line. A monochrome or greyscale panel keeps its own levels.
JUSTOLED.THEME_CLASSIC: Classic: white, green bars with an amber top, red peak
JUSTOLED.THEME_FIRE: Fire: red bars with an orange top
JUSTOLED.COLOUR_DOC: Pick a colour; the display follows when you save.
JUSTOLED.SECTION_STANDBY_DOC: What the display shows while nothing plays, and when it goes dark.
JUSTOLED.PAUSE_STANDBY_DOC: Volumio's play button pauses rather than stops, so a paused player is the usual resting state. On, a pause is treated as a stop after the seconds below: the standby screen, then dark after the minutes below. Off, the pause message (or the still face) stays until the player stops or plays.
JUSTOLED.PAUSE_TIMEOUT_DOC: 0 shows standby the moment the player pauses; a few seconds show the pause message first. Playing again brings the face back at once.
JUSTOLED.IDLE_SCREEN_DOC: The time and date, with the player's address, or nothing at all.
JUSTOLED.IDLE_TIMEOUT_DOC: Minutes of standby before the display switches off; 0 keeps the clock on. It comes back when something plays.
JUSTOLED.CLOCK_FORMAT_DOC: How the time is written on the standby screen.
JUSTOLED.DATE_FORMAT_DOC: How the date is written under the clock.
JUSTOLED.SHOW_IP_DOC: The IP address in the corner of the standby screen, handy for reaching the player.
JUSTOLED.SAVED: Saved. The display follows the new settings.
JUSTOLED.SAVED_RESTART: Saved. A restart is needed for the bus change to take effect.
JUSTOLED.SAVE_FAILED: Saved to the plugin, but the system could not be updated: {{error}}
JUSTOLED.SERVICE_FAILED: The display service could not be started: {{error}}
JUSTOLED.RESTART_MSG: Just OLED's audio tap joins the player's audio chain when Volumio starts. Restart now so the display can follow the music, or continue and restart later.
